title: Network Links
description: One row of Replica's "Network Links" dataset. Derived from the published schema table at https://documentation.replicahq.com/docs/network-links.

stableEdgeId.description: A unique identifier for the network link.

startLat.description: The latitude of the starting point of the network link, stored in decimal degrees.

startLon.description: The longitude of the starting point of the network link, stored in decimal degrees.

endLat.description: The latitude of the end point of the network link, stored in decimal degrees.

endLon.description: The longitude of the end point of the network link, stored in decimal degrees.

streetName.description: The common name of the network link if available. Matches the name assigned by OpenStreetMap.

distance.description: The distance (length) of the network link in millimeters.

osmid.description: The OpenStreetMap ID assigned to the network link.

speed.description: The speed limit on the link in miles per hour.

flags.description: A flag denoting what type of vehicles and pedestrian traffic are permitted on the network edge.

lanes.description: The number of travel lanes on the network link. A "-1" value means we could not parse a lane count from OpenStreetMap (OSM). A "0" value means that the road isn't passable by cars (i.e., it doesn't have the allows_car flag that appears in the "flags" column in the table).

highway.description: The classification of the link based on OpenStreetMap data.

geometry.description: The geometry type for each network link including the start and end latitude and longitude points of the link segment.
